name: cc-autotitle
description: Names each Claude Code session on its own: after a few turns it picks a short kebab-case name from the whole session, and renames it again when the work moves on. It never touches a name you set by hand.

firstAfterTurns.title: First name after (turns)
firstAfterTurns.description: The turn after which the session gets its first name. Before that, Claude Code's own title stays.

recheckEveryTurns.title: Re-check every (turns)
recheckEveryTurns.description: Turns between checks of whether the name still fits the work; a compaction also triggers one. 0 names a session once and never re-checks.
